course.title: Electrical and Electronic Engineering BEng | University of Nottingham
quotes: A levels AAB IB 32 points overall

Required subjects Maths and one of electronics, computer science, physics, chemistry, biology, further mathematics, design and technology: systems control or design technology: design engineering H404.

IB score 32 points overall or 655 in 3 Higher Level Certificates. IB requirements One of HL5 Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches, HL5 Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation OR SL6 Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches AND 5 at HL in one of biology, chemistry, physics or computer science.
Duration 3 years full-time Location University Park Campus Select start date September 2027
The entrance requirements listed apply to 2027 entry.
IELTS 6.0 (no less than 5.5 in any element)
